thread:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout v2.2.0 -> prod (canary group A, 5%). Feature flag: streaming_payload_enum=true.
sre-bot: Alert: spike in 5xx on /v1/stream in us-west-2 canary hosts. 5xx rate -> 4.1% (baseline 0.2%).
mira: oncall here, looking. @diego can you grab runtime logs from canary-instance-3?
diego: pulling logs now.
priya: support: we have 3 customer reports (Acme, BetaBank, Shoply) reporting streaming sessions failing with immediate disconnects. Tickets linked.
diego: found repeating stacktrace in canary logs:
```
HandshakeError: invalid enum for field payload_mode: expected string got number
  at /srv/runtime/stream/handshake.js:87:22
  payload: { client: "sdk-js", version: "2.1.7", payload_mode: 2 }
```
mira: hmm, payload_mode 2? our server should accept both numeric+string historically. Did the canary change validation?
diego: yes — the new validation landed in v2.2.0: we switched to strict string-only enums (json schema tightened). Looks like older SDK clients (sdk-js@<=2.1.x) send numeric enum codes. Canary hosts running v2.2 reject them.
priya: customers mostly on older sdk-js versions per support logs.
samir: deploying v2.2 was supposed to be backward compatible. I see the schema change in commit 8f2b3d that removed the numeric branch. My mistake.
mira: immediate mitigation — can we flip the FF to disable strict validation? or toggle canary back?
diego: two options: 1) revert schema validation remotely via FF, 2) kill the canary rollout and rollback to v2.1.9. Which is faster?
sre-bot: current canary traffic 5% => ~12k streaming sessions/min. Error rate on canary instances 4.1%. Non-canary unaffected.
priya: priority one: reduce customer impact. I'd vote rollback to v2.1.9 for prod and pause rollout.
mira: agree. @deploy-bot execute kill-switch for canary group and pause rollout.
deploy-bot: running: redwoodctl rollout pause --name v2.2.0 --env prod --group canary-A
deploy-bot: pause acknowledged. Now executing rollback to v2.1.9 (can take ~3m).
diego: while rollback runs, I'll open a small compatibility middleware to accept numeric enums for a short window if rollback fails. Pushing patch to canary hotfix branch.
priya: logged customer communication: "We're investigating streaming failures; we've paused the rollout and are rolling back. ETA ~10-15 minutes." :phone: @support-channel
sre-bot: rollback complete on canary hosts. 5xx rate -> 0.25% and trending down.
mira: thanks. All canary hosts now at v2.1.9. I'm going to hold the global rollout.
diego: patch diff prepared to reintroduce numeric enum acceptance behind feature flag ff.allow_numeric_payload_mode. Canary test passed locally.
samir: we need to decide long term: enforce string enums (cleaner) but require coordinated SDK bump and dep migration. For now let's rollout an emergency FF to accept numeric while we coordinate SDK upgrade.
mira: create FF, set to true in prod for 1 hour then roll out planned upgrade window. Command?
diego: redwoodctl ff set allow_numeric_payload_mode true --env prod --until 2026-03-15T15:30Z
deploy-bot: feature flag updated: allow_numeric_payload_mode=true (propagated to prod in ~30s).
sre-bot: monitoring: error rate back to baseline ~0.15%.
priya: support update sent to customers: rollback complete; temporary flag enabled to accept older SDKs; we will coordinate SDK release note and recommend customers upgrade.
mira: handing off to @ryan for follow-up and postmortem. I'll be available but switching to next rotation.
ryan: ack, taking over. Next steps: 1) postmortem doc + timeline, 2) patch release plan to re-enable strict validation with SDK coordinated upgrade, 3) follow up with top 10 impacted customers.
samir: I'll open a PR to revert the strict validation commit and prepare the compatibility plan.
diego: also adding a canary gating check in CI to validate handshake with sdk-js@2.1.x and sdk-js@2.2.x before future rollouts.
ryan: estimated customer impact: ~3 customers reported directly, ~0.6% of total streaming sessions in prod during canary window affected, no data loss reported. Severity: SEV2.
priya: closing tickets as "mitigated, pending follow-up" and assigned to eng-runbook.
ryan: postmortem owners: ryan (lead), diego (runtime root cause), samir (deploy/process), priya (customer comms). ETA postmortem draft within 48 hours.
mira: thanks team :thumbsup:
